adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, calendar sync is performed via `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` using an `EventManager` constructed from the *caller* (`const { user } = ctx; ... const credentials = await getUsersCredentials(ctx.user); const eventManager = new EventManager({ ...user, credentials: [...credentials] });`). This means if an attendee (or a team admin who isn’t the organizer) calls `addGuests`, the code will attempt to update the booking’s calendar event using the caller’s credentials rather than the organizer/booking owner’s credentials (even though the organizer and booking.user data are loaded). That can cause calendar updates to fail or update the wrong calendar depending on permissions/ownership.
